snippet.title: Flight Control for Nintendo DSiWare - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Flight Control, the world-wide #1 iPhone game with more than 2,000,000 copies sold, is finally available on Nintendo DSiWare! Incredibly simple yet insanely addictive, touch and drag planes to their landing strips - but don't let them collide. Includes brand-new "Windy" map set among a snow storm! See http://firemint.com/?page_id=802 for more info.
